summary.text: Paul Fielder is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 14 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A wildlife biologist by career, he first won election to the House in 2020 and has served as chair and vice chair of the House Taxation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paul Fielder's career experience includes working as a wildlife biologist.
Fielder won the Republican primary and then the November 3, 2020 general election for Montana House District 13, defeating Democrat Colleen Hinds and Libertarian Cade Stiles.
He won re-election in 2022 in District 13 and in 2024 in District 14, defeating Hinds both times.
Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2021, and his current term ends on January 4, 2027.

Fielder chaired the House Taxation Committee in the 2023-2024 session and was its vice chair in 2025-2026; he also sits on the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, House Rules, and Fish, Wildlife and Parks committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
